method: Building-local planar Cartesian. Building X increases to the right/eastward in the drawing, local Y increases towards the REAR/top. The renderer graph uses x metres and z metres increasing towards FRONT; building Y(mm) = 14400 - z(m)*1000. No geographic latitude/longitude assumed.
